pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with rounded, smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Patch size is heterogeneous, with larger areas on the upper flank and neck, transitioning to smaller, more sub-circular shapes on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are well-defined. Path thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-section, with a slight decrease in pixel-width on the lower posterior region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible as a dark, fuzzy 1D contour along the upper neck with a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile against the bright background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark-pigmented bird perched on the dorsal ridge at the base of the neck, creating a localized silhouette anomaly.
